name: open-blank-pdf
expr: (async () => { const d = await PDFLib.PDFDocument.create(); d.addPage([595, 842]); const b = await d.save(); await ZT.openB64(ZT.b64(b), 'p.pdf'); return 'opened'; })()

name: prediction-off-still-writes

ZT.liveState().predLen : -1, errors: window.__ZT_ERRORS, ink: ZT.inkStats(0) }); })()
